test_cases.name: Cross-account draft leakage prevention
test_cases.scenario: User A ('user-123') enters title 'Wedding of Kosal & Bopha'. Auth context switches to User B ('user-456').
test_cases.expected_result: User B sees blank title or User B's draft. User A's draft is not leaked or written into user-456 storage.
test_cases.test_evidence: Phase11_1DraftLifecycle.test.jsx: test('TC-RACE-01: does not leak draft across user accounts')

test_cases.name: Pending event ID recovery across browser reload
test_cases.scenario: Event is created with ID 'evt_partial_999', but cover upload fails. Page reloads.
test_cases.expected_result: sessionStorage retains pendingEventId 'evt_partial_999'; UI offers retry without re-POSTing /api/events.
test_cases.test_evidence: Phase11_1DraftLifecycle.test.jsx: test('TC-RACE-02: persists pendingEventId to sessionStorage')

test_cases.name: Cover photo session notice display
test_cases.scenario: User selects cover photo file; inspect wizard step 2.
test_cases.expected_result: Notice is visible informing user that photo files are held in session memory and not stored in drafts.
test_cases.test_evidence: Phase11_1DraftLifecycle.test.jsx: test('TC-RACE-03: displays draft photo notice')

test_cases.name: SessionStorage QuotaExceeded fallback
test_cases.scenario: Storage quota simulated as full (throw QuotaExceededError on setItem).
test_cases.expected_result: Gracefully caught; component logs warning; form remains interactive without unhandled exception.
